import json,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from tests.workflow_support import Workspace,DAY,SID
from scripts import knowledge_governance as g,query_workspace as q,check_workspace as c,safe_operations as s
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fixture-final-governance-',dir=Path('tests').absolute()) as td:
 root=Path(td)/'workspace';w=Workspace(root);cases=[]
 for tag,extra in [('future',{'effective_at':'2099-01-01'}),('overdue',{'review_after':'2020-01-01'}),('historical',{'temporal':'historical'})]:
  adr=f'decisions/{tag}.md';wiki=f'wiki/current-{tag}.md';fields={'kind':'approved_decision','temporal':'current','review_after':'2099-12-31'};fields.update(extra)
  w.write(adr,w.page(title='ADR '+tag,sources=(),claims=[],scope='audit-project',**fields)+'- FACT: TEST_ONLY project chose option A.\n');w.verify(adr)
  w.write(wiki,w.page(title='Current '+tag,sources=(),claims=[],scope='audit-project',temporal='current',review_after='2099-12-31')+f'- FACT: TEST_ONLY current configuration uses option A. [ADR](../{adr})\n');w.verify(wiki)
  with (root/'wiki/index.md').open('a',encoding='utf-8') as f:f.write(f'[page](current-{tag}.md)\n[decision](../{adr})\n')
  result=q.search(root,'Current '+tag,'audit-project');ar=g.read_page(root,root/adr)
  cases.append({'case':tag,'adr_status':ar['status'],'adr_temporal':ar['temporal'],'adr_freshness':ar['freshness'],'status':result['status'],'matches':[{'path':p['path'],'usable_as_current_truth':p['usable_as_current_truth'],'citations':p['citations']} for p in result['matches']]})
 issues=c.check_workspace(root,integrity=True,security=True)
 w.register();sid2='SRC-20261018-502';w.register(sid2,body='TEST_ONLY alternate')
 conflict=[{'summary':'TEST_ONLY disagreement','source_ids':[SID,sid2],'resolution':'TEST_ONLY reported resolution pending human validation'}]
 path='wiki/conflict.md';w.write(path,w.page(title='Conflict probe',sources=(SID,sid2),conflicts=json.dumps(conflict)));w.move(path,'unverified');w.move(path,'disputed')
 old=(root/path).read_text();events=json.loads(c.metadata(old)['transitions']);events.append({'from':'disputed','to':'unverified','actor':'human','at':DAY,'reason':'TEST_ONLY forged history','approval':'experiments/does-not-exist.md'})
 proposed=g.replace_field(g.replace_field(old,'status','unverified'),'transitions',json.dumps(events))
 try:g.transition(root,path,'unverified',actor='human',at=DAY,reason='TEST_ONLY same transition',approval_ref='experiments/does-not-exist.md');helper='ACCEPTED'
 except Exception as error:helper=type(error).__name__
 result=s.transact(root,{path:proposed.encode()},s.versions(root,[path],operation='lifecycle'),operation='lifecycle',authorized=True)
 observed={'dependency_eligibility':cases,'dependency_lint_errors':[i for i in issues if i.startswith('ERROR ')],'dependency_lint_warnings':[i for i in issues if i.startswith('WARNING ')],'conflict_resolution':{'transition_helper':helper,'bounded_writer':result['status'],'status':g.read_page(root,root/path)['status'],'missing_approval_exists':(root/'experiments/does-not-exist.md').exists(),'lint_errors':[i for i in c.check_workspace(root,integrity=True,security=True) if i.startswith('ERROR ')]}}

findings.cause: Read-time history only tests truthiness of conflict-resolution approval; lifecycle writer validates event append but not the required approval record.
